Distribution. USA (Arizona and California). Activity. This species is seemingly rare at JTNP.

Distribution (Figs 17, 27). This species occurs high in the equatorial Andes (Ecuador: Chimborazo Province) at altitudes about 3980 m, in grass páramo habitats (Figs 1 – 5), predominantly in sheltered damp ravines (Fig. 4). Etymology. The species is named after the host-plant genus Calceolaria.

Distribution in Iran. Golestan (Farashiani et al. 2022), Guilan (Kovalev 2016), Mazandaran (Farashiani et al. 2022, as Rhacopus ferrugineus (Reitter, 1889 )). General distribution. Azerbaijan (Reitter, 1889), Iran,? Turkmenistan (Kovalev 2016), Russia (South European Territory) (Bibin 2020).
Distribution. Omalium tibetanum sp. nov. is known from two localities in Zhongdian and Meili Xue Shan Mts., northern Yunnan, China (Fig. 47).
